name: Primal Ember
description: Throw an ember of the oldest fire that no water or wind or ordinary guard can put out.

name: First Veil
description: Wear the first veil of fire that was ever lit and let it burn every blow that touches it.

name: Origin Heat
description: Draw heat from the source of fire itself and pour it into the user's whole body.

name: Kindling Gaze
description: Look into any fire and read the history of the heat in it back to its first spark.

name: Genesis Burn
description: Strike with a burn that begins at the first spark of the world and runs forward through the target.

name: Ancient Pyre
description: Raise a pyre of ancient fire that has burned since before names and spread it wide.

name: Elder Shroud
description: Cloak the body in an elder shroud of fire that turns even heavy qi attacks aside.

name: Ruling Blaze
description: Command every lesser flame in range to bow and hold the foe under the user's blaze.

name: Sovereign Flame
description: Make all fire in range the user's own and turn it on the foe in a single sweep.

name: Eternal Kindling
description: Keep a sacred kindling alive that returns heat to the user as fast as it is spent.

name: Worldburn
description: Set the world alight at the full destructive ceiling of a Core and let the fire spread unchecked.

name: Honest Fire
description: Burn a spoken lie out of the minds that heard it so it can no longer be believed; no qi mechanic explains this.

name: Ashen Ember
description: Throw a grey ember that holds the last heat of a fire and drains the warmth of what it touches.

name: Embered Shroud
description: Wrap the body in a shroud of old embers that does not fade under any pressure.

name: Final Warmth
description: Give an ally the last warmth of a spent fire to close wounds and ease the dying.

name: Remnant Sense
description: Read from a heap of ash what burned there and when and by whose hand.

name: Cremating Wave
description: Send a slow wave of cremating heat across the near ground that leaves only white ash.

name: Last Kindle
description: Light the last flame in the body and spend every ember of strength in one great surge.

name: Remnant Pyre
description: Raise a pyre from the ash of a past fire and burn it again with the old heat doubled.

name: Cinder Verdict
description: Pass a single verdict of fire through the target's guard and body in one stroke.

name: Fading Blaze
description: Let a vast blaze burn down slowly so that its dying heat presses on all who remain in it.

name: Perennial Fire
description: Keep a fire that returns every spring of strength to allies and guards them from harm.

name: Ash Cycle
description: Burn and reburn the same ash in turn so that each fire is fiercer than the last.

name: Worldpyre
description: Build a pyre the size of the realm's reach and burn all in it to the full destructive ceiling of the Divine realm.

name: Unburn
description: Reverse a fire's work so that a thing and a person it consumed return as they stood before; no qi mechanic explains this.

name: Fuelless Fire
description: Burn a fire that consumes no fuel and no qi yet takes away what the target is; no qi mechanic explains this.
